Class RmiServerImpl

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.it.network.server.RmiServerImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
RmiServer, Serializable, Remote
public class RmiServerImpl extends UnicastRemoteObject implements RmiServer
Server-side RMI implementation.

Exported in the RMI registry under "MesosServer". Shares LobbyServer with the Socket server so mixed-transport games use the same lobby and nickname authority.

Each RMI client callback is wrapped in an RmiClientHandler, which implements ClientConnection and makes the transport transparent to GameSession.
